Q5787.reason: Intent only to inflict a slight wound is not malice aforethought, and with no heat-of-passion killing the unintended death is involuntary manslaughter.

Q8553.reason: Alcoholism plus steatorrhea depletes magnesium, and hypomagnesemia suppresses PTH enough to cause severe hypocalcemic tetany that vitamin D deficiency would usually compensate for.

Q5028.reason: A merely proposed school designation in a brochure and recorded plat, with no deed covenant or completed dedication, is only an unenforceable restriction.
